subject: Q1 wrap — scores, micro-retrospectives, draft narratives
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Q1 wrap — scores, micro-retrospectives, draft narratives

Team,

As we close the quarter I need everyone to do three quick things by EOD Wed (Feb 25):
1) Add a numeric score for each OKR key result in the attached Q1_OKR_scores.csv (0-1 scale, two decimals).
2) In team_micro_retros.docx, add a 2-3 sentence micro-retro per objective (what worked, one concrete fix).
3) Draft a 1-paragraph narrative for the QBR per team in QBR_narrative_draft.md — focus on signal, not noise.

Notes on scoring: be strict on what counts as complete; if a metric is noisy, mark confidence (high/med/low) in the comments column. I'll consolidate and circulate the final narrative Friday morning.

Attachments: Q1_OKR_scores.csv (template), team_micro_retros.docx (per-objective champ comments), QBR_narrative_draft.md (starter bullets).

Plan: consolidated deck + narrative out Thu for review, dry-run Mon before exec QBR.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:05:12 -0000
Subject: Re: Q1 wrap — scores, micro-retrospectives, draft narratives

Marcus —

I've uploaded scores for Product Strategy and Platform objectives into the CSV (see comments column). Quick highlights:
- Product Strategy KR1: 0.82 (we hit target but with softer retention in cohort B; confidence = medium)
- Platform KR3: 0.45 (rollout delays; we did hit throughput improvements but not at the target SLA)

Micro-retro (Product Strategy): The growth experiments accelerated top-of-funnel but we under-indexed on onboarding steps — plan is to pair growth with product ops for the next sprint to reduce drop-off.

I flagged one KR where the metric definition changed mid-quarter — need to agree whether to carry forward adjusted baseline or treat as new in Q2.

Attachment: exported a cleaned CSV named Q1_OKR_scores_laura_v1.csv (same schema).

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Growth
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:30:45 -0000
Subject: Re: Q1 wrap — scores, micro-retrospectives, draft narratives

Adding my scores and a short note on the experimentation objective. Two asks:
1) For any KR that depends on the new inference runtime, please surface the per-region variance (eu/us) — metrics team can export.
2) For narratives, suggest a single signal sentence + one bullet for context. Keeps deck slides concise for the execs.

I also pushed a draft narrative paragraph for Platform into the shared doc (QBR_narrative_draft.md). Made minor language edits to emphasize cost-per-token improvements and operational reliability gains.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:45:07 -0000
Subject: Re: Q1 wrap — scores, micro-retrospectives, draft narratives

Thanks for starting this, Marcus. I filled in the CS & Support objectives and added a short customer-impact section for the narrative draft. Highlights:
- Renewal motion: closed-loop with account teams improved NRR but we saw a small uptick in troubleshooting tickets after the mid-quarter rollout (tracked under Support KR2).
- Request: can someone export the per-team ticket latency trend for Jan–Feb so I can add a two-line context sentence?

I also put a short retrospective bullet for CS: "Shifted from reactive playbooks to asynchronous playbooks; reduces 1:1 handoffs but needs more automation to scale."

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 16:10:02 -0000
Subject: Re: Q1 wrap — scores, micro-retrospectives, draft narratives

Great work — I've consolidated the CSVs and incorporated the micro-retros into the narrative. Key decisions and next steps:
- Final scoring set in Q1_OKR_scores.csv (master) — I normalized conflicting definitions and added a change log row where we agreed to treat mid-quarter metric definition updates as exceptions.
- Narrative: consolidated doc is linked below; I trimmed each team to one signal sentence + one supporting bullet as suggested.
- Data asks: Aditya — please share per-region runtime variance export by EOD Fri so I can add the figure slide. Evelyn — include the ticket latency export when available; I'll slot it into the appendix.
- Dry-run for leadership QBR: Mon Mar 1, 10:00–11:00 PT (calendar invite to follow).

Attachments: Q1_OKR_scores.csv (master), QBR_narrative_final.md
Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xq4-example-QBR-narrative/edit

If there are no objections I'll publish the consolidated deck + narrative to the exec read-ahead on Thu morning.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
